description:
PERF, depends on fz-90r (delta refactor). After fz-90r makes project_source pure (writes captured in a returnable delta), the fold still re-derives shared callees ~hundreds of times: shared library executables (Enum.reduce[int] etc.) reached from many callers each re-run project_callsite_return -> the callee's ExecutableReturn frame. Measured: 105,422 project_source calls to produce 53 facts on enum_take_drop_split.

FIX: memoize project_source.
- Key: (ExecutableKey, TransportSource, RuntimeDemand, Ty) -- the existing cycle `frame` plus ty (shape depends on ty; the cycle guard didn't need it).
- Only cache publication.is_none() frames. Publication-bearing frames are shallow, top-level, hit once, and their delta is publication-specific -> must stay uncached. The hot redundant frames come through project_callsite_return, which passes publication=None -> exactly the cacheable set.
- Value: (SourceShape, TransportFactsBuilder /* the frame's own delta */). On hit: facts.merge(&cached_delta) + return shape. merge is idempotent (extend_unique) so re-merging on every hit is safe; hot frames carry empty deltas so the hit is effectively shape-only.

SOUNDNESS UNDER CYCLES (the real hazard): recursive fz functions re-enter a frame -> Recursive; a frame's result is context-independent only if its back-edges target ITSELF, not an enclosing frame. Carry Tarjan low-link: project_source returns the min stack-depth of any back-edge its subtree hit; a frame at depth k is cacheable iff that min >= k (self-edges target k -> cacheable; an ancestor edge targets <k -> compute fresh). Caches every acyclic frame and every self-recursive one (the hot set; Enum.* compile to self-recursion); conservatively recomputes only genuine MUTUAL recursion. visiting gains a HashMap<FrameKey,usize> for O(1) depth.

VERIFY: probe -- project_source calls -> distinct-frames (tens-low hundreds). lib + matrix green, zero warnings. Re-verify vs HEAD at execution.
title: Transport projection: memoize publication-free source frames
